subject: Fix persisting missing make variables (#2881)
reason: The change touches only src/Makefile's persist-settings target, adding PROG_SUFFIX and USE_FAST_FLOAT to the .make-settings file so that changing those build flags triggers a rebuild. It is a build-system fix with no runtime behaviour change: no command, reply, persistence, replication, or cluster path is affected, so no fuzzer scenario can reach it.
